reading.body:
Two academic groups make up this category, Stanford's NLP Group and the UC Berkeley lab that produced vLLM, both verified against their own institutional pages in August 2026.

The two entries point to different kinds of academic output. Stanford NLP is listed as a research group without a named flagship project in this data, while the UC Berkeley entry traces a specific line from lab to product, vLLM originated in the Sky Computing Lab and now appears elsewhere on this site as an open-source inference engine with its own GitHub tracking. That a university lab's research artifact graduated into a separately catalogued open-source project is the one concrete pattern this small dataset shows.

With only two entries, this category cannot support a claim about how many university labs work on AI or how their output compares. It documents two specific labs and, for one of them, one specific downstream project.
